periods.time: One week after Welf forges Bell's new short blade

name.zh: 埃伊娜准许贝尔小队进入中层
name.en: Eina Clears Bell's Party for the Middle Floors

periods.summary: Bell reports Welf as his new contracted smith and party member, then asks whether his three-person party may enter the middle floors. Eina checks Bell's Lv.2 status, sees his rapid growth, judges the party barely acceptable for the 13th floor, and approves entry on the condition that every member equip Salamander Wool before going in.
periods.cause: Bell's party has expanded to Bell, Welf, and Lili, and Bell's Lv.2 ability values have grown high enough for the 13th-14th floor benchmark.
periods.process: Eina discusses the Crozzo name, inspects Bell's status, considers the party's imbalance, leaves briefly, and returns with discount tickets for Salamander Wool. She strictly orders Bell not to enter the middle floors until everyone has the protective cloth.
periods.outcome: Bell receives conditional approval to challenge the middle floors and internalizes Eina's tension about that unknown stage.
periods.aftermath: Bell goes to join Lili and Welf, equipped with Eina's warning and preparation requirement.
periods.significance: This event formally moves Bell's party from upper-floor progression into middle-floor exploration under Guild-supervised safety conditions.
